metaDescription: Miro is an online whiteboard for brainstorming, diagramming, workshops and planning, with templates, AI and integrations. See its features, Free, Starter, Business and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Miro is an online collaborative whiteboard where teams brainstorm, diagram, run workshops and plan projects together. Boards combine sticky notes and shapes with Docs, Tables, Timelines, Kanban and Slides on the same canvas.

Miro includes more than 7,000 Miro and community-made templates, integrations with tools like Zoom, Slack and Google Drive, and Miro AI for generating images, docs, diagrams and slides using monthly AI credits. The free plan includes three editable boards; paid plans are charged per member.

features.title: Infinite canvas
features.text: Brainstorm and diagram on an infinite whiteboard, together in real time.

features.title: Docs, Tables and Slides
features.text: Docs, Tables, Timelines, Kanban and Slides right on the canvas.

features.title: 7,000+ templates
features.text: Start faster with Miro and community-made templates.

features.title: Miro AI
features.text: Generate images, docs, diagrams and slides with monthly AI credits.

features.title: Meeting tools
features.text: Timer, voting, video chat and estimation for workshops, from Starter.

features.title: Integrations and MCP
features.text: Connect Zoom, Slack, Google Drive and more, with an MCP server on Business.

strengths: A free plan with unlimited members.
Docs, tables and slides on the same canvas.
On paid plans, people can edit shared boards without signing up.
limitations: The free plan has only 3 editable boards.
Starter and Business charge for every member added.
Multiple teams and private workspaces need the Business plan.
AI credits are limited: 25 a month on Free and Starter.
Enterprise starts at 30 members, with custom pricing.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Paid plans are charged per member; prices below are billed yearly, with monthly billing costing more. Business has a 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 3 editable boards · unlimited members · 25 AI credits/mo

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: Billed yearly, or $10 monthly · unlimited boards · high-res exports

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Billed yearly, or $25 monthly · multiple teams · AI workflows · MCP server

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: From 30 members · security and governance at scale
